body:
WHAT
Interrupting aborts the running turn's provider stream and tool calls through an AbortController, propagates the abort to every foreground subagent, stops all background jobs, and (in the Engine) settles any pending question round with the answers collected so far so nothing waits forever. The turn ends with stopReason 'aborted' and a system reminder recording the interruption, with dangling tool_use blocks repaired by synthetic tool_results.

WHY
Without a hard stop that reaches subagents and open questions, the UI's stop button leaves tokens burning in a child or a promise hanging on a question card nobody will answer.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.interrupt() (abortController.abort, liveChildren[*].interrupt(), stopBackgroundTasks()), Session.runTurn() catch block (`signal.aborted` → stopReason 'aborted', syntheticToolResults/unansweredToolUseIds repair), Session.streamAssistantTurn() passes `signal` to provider.stream, Session.executeToolCalls() uses signal.throwIfAborted(). engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — Engine.send() case 'interrupt' (calls session.interrupt(), resolves every pendingQuestions entry with collected answers, emits '⏹ stopped').

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With a FakeProvider whose scripted turn has a long text, calling session.interrupt() during streaming makes runTurn resolve (not reject) and emit turn_finished with stopReason 'aborted'.
2. After the interrupted turn, the last user message contains '<system-reminder>The user interrupted this turn before it finished.</system-reminder>' and, when a tool_use was pending, a synthetic tool_result for each unanswered toolUseId.
3. Interrupting a parent while a foreground subagent (spawnAgent) is mid-turn aborts the child's stream too: the child's FakeProvider sees its signal aborted and no further child requests are made.
4. Engine 'interrupt' during a pending AskUserQuestion round resolves the askUser promise with the partial answers immediately, so the turn finishes without a question_response.
5. Calling interrupt() on an idle session does not throw and the Engine emits '⏹ nothing was running.'.
